wages.text: Stefani says she will advocate for frontline workers to receive a living wage.
wages.quote: Catherine will prioritize the well-being of frontline workers, advocating for their safety and ensuring they receive a living wage.

housing.text: Stefani says building new homes at all income levels should be made as easy as possible.
housing.quote: We need to make it as easy as possible to construct the new homes we desperately need for residents at all income levels.

schools.text: Stefani pledges to increase funding for public schools and teachers.
schools.quote: Catherine will advocate for increased funding for schools and teachers to ensure they have the resources to support our students.

sentencing.text: Stefani wants to legally reclassify domestic violence as a violent crime.
sentencing.quote: In the Assembly, she will work to redefine domestic violence as a violent crime, recognizing its severe consequences and advocating for appropriate measures.

guns.text: Stefani introduced California's first ghost gun ban and pledges to keep pushing gun violence prevention laws.
guns.quote: Catherine introduced the first ghost gun ban in California, and will continue to fight for comprehensive gun violence prevention laws.

abortion.text: Stefani says she strongly supports reproductive freedom and protecting abortion access.
abortion.quote: Catherine has been unwavering in her support of reproductive freedom and will be a leader in the fight to protect women's healthcare autonomy in Sacramento.

health.text: Stefani supports a state single-payer healthcare system.
health.quote: She supports Governor Newsom's comprehensive single-payer healthcare system.
